_note: exp-038 weight-space repair (ADR 0042). Read by components/decomposer/weight_space_repair.py. Every number that shapes a run is here; the script hard-codes none. A separate track OUTSIDE the few-shot pool study: nothing here changes any pool-study arm.
_adapter_path_note: Relative to runs_root (configs/paths.json). The exp-026 pool-only fine-tune (pool_2000_imbalanced), chosen as the target in ADR 0042: on the pinned 600 it under-decomposes at 4 hops (0.465) while barely over-decomposing (0.035), so the defect is one-sided; every prompting arm mixes it with heavy over-decomposition.
_quantization_note: fp16 base + adapter, merged in fp16, as exp-026 evaluated (ADR 0034 decision 3). Edits are computed in float32 and cast back.

data._note: Locating and validation data come ONLY from the MuSiQue TRAIN split (datasets.musique_train). Excluded before drawing: the adapter's 2,000 training rows (its behaviour on memorised rows is not the defect), and - asserted, not assumed - every id and every normalised question text of the whole MuSiQue dev file, which contains the ADR 0007 pinned 600. Direction finding never sees the pinned 600: that is the leakage guard of ADR 0042.
data._splits_note: locate: activations and directions. val_select: layer scoring (AUROC) and the candidate sweep. val_confirm: one confirmation run of the chosen edit and its controls, never used for choosing (the discovery-vs-confirmation gap reported by arXiv 2611.09382).

generation._note: Greedy, max_new_tokens as configs/decomposer_musique.json generation_overrides. Batched with left padding for the TRAIN-side locate/sweep only; the pinned-600 evaluation runs through run_decomposer.py, unbatched, exactly as exp-026.

locate._directions_note: Both matched on boundary index j (src/weight_space.py matched_diff_of_means). stop_vs_continue is the Arditi-style 'what makes it stop' direction; premature_vs_correct_stop compares a too-early stop with a correct stop at the SAME j (a 2-hop item stopping after step 2 vs a 3/4-hop item stopping after step 2), i.e. what differs when stopping is wrong. Which one, if either, repairs the defect is decided on val_select.

sweep._final_norm_scale_note: 0.6 is the norm-only factor arXiv 2611.20953 reports for its 10- and 25-pass runs. Under greedy decoding a uniform logit scale cannot change the argmax, so this control is expected to leave every output unchanged up to fp16 rounding; it is run to show that, not assumed.

selection_rule._note: Pre-registered default rule (src/weight_space.py select_candidate). Claude, inspecting the saved statistics, may choose differently only with a written reason in experiments/exp-038/choices.md BEFORE any pinned-600 generation.
